description: Full body figure of a Malaysian man in his late 20s, wearing a neat light blue long-sleeved button-up shirt tucked into charcoal grey trousers with a black leather belt and black formal shoes. He has short, styled black hair and a clean-shaven face.

Full body figure of a Malaysian man in his early 40s, wearing a bright yellow promotional polo shirt with a generic logo on the chest, paired with beige khaki pants and comfortable brown walking shoes. He has a friendly face and short black hair.

Full body anonymous human figure depicted as a featureless dark silhouette with glowing blue digital circuitry lines running across its form, standing in a void. It has 1-2 differentiating traits: a singular glowing red digital eye in the center of its head and metallic silver hands.

Full body figure of a Malaysian man in his 30s, dressed in a professional dark blue Royal Malaysia Police uniform with silver buttons, visible insignia on the shoulders, a black utility belt, and polished black tactical boots. He has a disciplined posture and a short, neat regulation haircut.
